title: perf+feat(core): ADR-0079 Phase 2 — nameField canonical + memoize derived title
body:
ADR-0079 follow-ups in the shared record-title resolver (`@object-ui/core`).

- **`nameField` canonical, `titleFormat` de-prioritized (conservative retirement).** New precedence: view `titleField` → **`nameField`** → `displayNameField` (alias) → `titleFormat` (legacy, kept for back-compat, now *after* the declared field) → type-aware derivation → `Record #<id>`. An object that declares `nameField` resolves via it even if it carries a stale `titleFormat`. `titleFormat` is **not** removed (existing objects + pinned spec still use it; full removal is a separate breaking migration) — just marked deprecated.
- **Perf: memoize the derived title field** per `objectDef` (WeakMap) instead of re-scanning `objectDef.fields` for every record — O(records×fields) → O(records) on large lists.

Tests: `@object-ui/core` record-title **66/66** (added: nameField-wins-over-stale-titleFormat, titleFormat back-compat, memoization).
